items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: Well, he worked with us only once. He was down in Houston, Texas, and he came over and played with us.

ctx.x: Did you ever work with him, too?
Well, he worked with us only once. He was down in Houston, Texas, and he came over and played with us.
He went over to Texas around 1914, I think, and stayed over that way. Yeah.
